# Kami Reader

Kami Reader is a reading-focused theme built on a print-grade serif design, applying warm parchment backgrounds, ink-blue accents and warm-gray neutrals to both the editor and preview. It carries light and dark variants, and its recorded style settings tune the body font and line height.

![Kami Reader screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkenny0/obsidian-kami/HEAD/screenshots/light-reading.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Kami Reader"
    author: "Kenny Wu"
    repo:   "kkenny0/obsidian-kami"
    slug:   "kami-reader"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/kami-reader"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/kkenny0/obsidian-kami"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkenny0/obsidian-kami/HEAD/screenshots/light-reading.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a print-grade serif design with warm parchment backgrounds, ink-blue accents, and warm-gray neutrals for a reading-focused Obsidian editor and preview. Adjust light/dark variants and tunable style settings to refine body font and line-height for comfortable typography."
}
```
